pinned.name: Time_Warp_Universe
pinned.description: Time Warp Studio is a desktop programming environment for ten languages of the 1960s and 1970s: BASIC, APL, Logo, PILOT, FOCAL, Forth, Scheme, COMAL, REXX and Smalltalk. Each one runs through its own interpreter, linked straight into the application rather than started as a separate process. Open a program and it runs; the debugger can stop inside

pinned.name: Mellivora_OS_PicoCalc
pinned.description: Mellivora OS port for the Clockwork PicoCalc handheld device, featuring a full shell, productivity applications, BASIC and Tiny C interpreters, scripting support, and extensive documentation.

pinned.name: Mellivora_OS
pinned.description: Mellivora OS is a from-scratch hobby OS that boots on real x86 hardware or in QEMU. It includes a custom HBFS v3 filesystem with permissions and xattr, ring 3 user-mode execution, a DOS-inspired interactive shell with POSIX features,

pinned.name: honey-ledger
pinned.description: Honey Ledger is a self-contained Electron desktop application for individuals who want full control over their financial data. And loads MicroSoft Money files!

pinned.name: HB_Briefing
pinned.description: Local-first RSS/Atom signal monitor: grades what matters, verifies flagged items, keeps dossiers and cited reports. GUI, TUI, web, CLI, WASM.

pinned.name: HB_SunRise
pinned.description: Resurrect decades-old Microsoft Money (.mny / .mbf) files natively on Windows, macOS, and Linux — zero dependencies, 100% offline.
